store.tagline: Your ssh config's hosts, one Enter from a terminal
features: Every named `Host` in `~/.ssh/config`, `Include` files followed one level, one section per file (`.ssh/config`, `.ssh/conf.d/work.conf`)
`HostName` under the name and searchable, `User` and `:port` on the right, a `via <jump>` tag for a `ProxyJump` host
`enter` opens a terminal window running `ssh <host>`: kitty, Ghostty, Alacritty, iTerm2 or Terminal on macOS, `$TERMINAL` on Linux
`cmd+shift+c` copies `ssh <host>`, `cmd+shift+j` the `ssh -J <jump> <host>` form for a machine without your config
`cmd+p` pings the host once and toasts the round trip (`web-1.example.com: 3 ms`), or why it did not answer
Optionally the names in `known_hosts` as a last section
